specification.exact_target: Number of down-regulated and up-regulated metabolites in positive ion mode for DSS vs CON comparison: 101 down-regulated and 125 up-regulated.
specification.blind_target: The count of metabolites that change in abundance in the DSS group compared to the CON group, as determined by volcano plot analysis in positive ion mode.

location_quotes.quote: In volcanic map analysis, the results showed that in positive ion mode, 101 metabolite levels were down-regulated and 125 metabolites were up-regulated in the DSS group compared to the CON group ( Figure 10A ).

method_quotes.quote: Fecal specimens were subjected to LC-MS-based untargeted metabolomics. In the sample preparation stage, precisely 50 mg of feces was combined with 1 mL of a methanolic/acetonitrile/water (2:2:1, v/v/v) extraction solution that included a 20 mg/L internal standard.
A pooled quality control (QC) sample was generated by combining aliquots of all individual extracts, and this QC pool was then injected into the LC-MS system for analysis.
One-way ANOVA was applied to assess differences among more than two groups, while comparisons between two specific groups were carried out with a t-test in GraphPad Prism 9.

specification.input_notes: The deposit contains 24 raw sequencing runs (SRR35674606–SRR35674629) under BioProject PRJNA1336462. These are the raw inputs for 16S rRNA gene sequencing and possibly metabolomics, but the paper does not specify which runs correspond to which sample or group. No processed data or metadata files are listed.
specification.comparison_metric: The observed counts of down-regulated and up-regulated metabolites from re-analysis of the deposited raw data will be compared to the reported counts (101 and 125).
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Counts must match exactly (101 down-regulated, 125 up-regulated).
specification.specification_gaps: The paper does not specify the exact software, parameters, or database used for metabolite identification and quantification; the mapping of SRR runs to experimental groups is not provided; the exact statistical thresholds for volcano plot analysis are not fully detailed.
